name: @guotree/magpie-websearch
description: Web search APIs for magpie: AnySearch, Keenable, Parallel and TinyFish with optional keys, plus Bocha, Jina, Kagi, Linkup, Metaso, Moonshot, Moonshot CN, Ollama, Perplexity, Querit, SerpApi, Serper, StepFun, Z.ai and Zhipu. Keys are managed by magpie.
